n: Calypso for Cozmo and Calypso curriculum
t: A rule-based language and curriculum for programming Cozmo robots.
steps: Find the Calypso site and read the curriculum page.
Confirm that you can get a Cozmo robot.
Confirm the requirements and install steps on the Calypso site.
Ask IT to install the software.
Connect the robot and test a simple rule.
Plan which students will share each robot.
